description:
Site Audit: the whole-site technical crawl. Fetches the homepage, sitemap and every internal link (robots.txt respected) up to max_pages, grades 170+ checks (error / warning / notice) and scores Site Health (0–100) and 9 themes.

Billing: 1¢ per 10 pages fetched (1,000 pages = $1.00, 10,000 = $10.00), billed as it crawls; link, image and script checks, site checks and Core Web Vitals on 10 pages included. Stops as "partial" if the balance runs out. dry_run: true quotes it free (estimated_cents from the sitemap size, max_cents at max_pages); confirm max_pages and the most it can cost with the user first.

When to call: 'audit my whole site' (technical SEO), or to re-check after fixes. One page: run_technical_audit; an earlier crawl: get_latest_crawl (free).

Timing: 3–6 pages a second. It runs ~40 s in this call: a small site comes back complete, a bigger one returns status "running" and keeps crawling; read it with get_latest_crawl. Core Web Vitals follow minutes later (cwv_state "pending"; never in Site Health). Optional settings (source, include/exclude, …): see each param; omit them to crawl the whole site.

Returns: { run_id, site_id, status: running|complete|partial|failed, coverage, pages_crawled, pages_found, pages_failed, skipped_by_rules, charged_cents, max_cost_cents, rejected?, site_health, counts: { errors, warnings, notices }, themes, cwv_state, checks: [{ id, severity, title, n, of }] (failing, worst first, ≤30; provisional while running), vs_previous?, note, suggested_next?, next_step }. One check's URLs and fix: get_crawl_issue (free).

cwv_urls.description: Up to 10 pages on the site to measure Core Web Vitals on, instead of the automatic sample.

device.description: desktop (default) or mobile user agent (both AuditAE-Bot).

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

dry_run.description: true: return the price quote (estimated_cents, max_cents, breakdown) and what would run. Nothing runs or bills.

exclude.description: Skip URLs matching these masks (include's syntax; exclude wins). Counted in skipped_by_rules.

exclude_checks.description: Check ids (checks[].id) to leave out of Site Health and the theme scores; they report not_run 'excluded'.

ignore_params.description: Query parameters to drop from URLs (e.g. ["sort", "page_*"]); ["*"] drops every query string.

include.description: Only crawl URLs whose path+query matches one of these masks (robots.txt syntax: * wildcard, $ end, else prefix; /shoes/ is the folder). The homepage is always fetched.

max_pages.description: Most pages to crawl, 1–10000 (default 10000: the whole site). 1¢ per 10 pages fetched.

robots_agent.description: Obey this bot's robots.txt group instead of User-agent: * (e.g. OAI-SearchBot, as ChatGPT search may crawl). Still identifies as AuditAE-Bot.

save_as_default.description: true: also save these settings (not urls) as the site's default for later crawls and schedules.

seed_url.description: Optional start URL on the site's own domain.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

sitemap_url.description: source=sitemap_url: the sitemap file or index to crawl; must be on the site.

source.description: What to crawl: site (default: links + sitemap), sitemaps (only the sitemaps' URLs), sitemap_url (one sitemap file), urls (only the listed URLs, plus the homepage). Default: the site's saved crawl settings, else site.

speed.description: normal (default, 3 at a time), polite (1 page a second; 10,000 pages ≈ 3 h) or robots (robots.txt Crawl-delay, max 10 s).

subdomains.description: Also crawl subdomains of the site's domain (each obeys its own robots.txt; up to 25 hosts). Default false.

urls.description: source=urls: up to 2,000 URLs on the site (off-site ones are rejected and returned in rejected). max_pages is clamped to the list.

name: crawl_site
title: Crawl a whole site (up to 10,000 pages) and run a Site Audit
